title: Print a greeting
summary: Bash: Print a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: printf writes formatted text. %s inserts a string and backslash-n ends the line.

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
printf puts the greeting into its %s slot. The format supplies the newline.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a fixed format string so data is not mistaken for formatting.
